title: Application and routing core
summary:
ASGI application class and the router that matches paths, builds route handlers, and wires dependencies, responses, and OpenAPI metadata into each endpoint.

Agent mapper reason: Application and router modules are tightly coupled and share the request lifecycle, so they are reviewed together.

ownedFiles.reason: Public package exports for FastAPI and its helpers.
FastAPI application class: route registration, middleware stack, exception handler setup, docs routes.
APIRouter and APIRoute: request handling, path matching, response construction, and route-level config.

contextFiles.reason: Dependency resolution called from route handling.
Route metadata consumed by OpenAPI generation.
Router include and route composition behavior.
Router startup and shutdown event behavior.
